description: Render two release notes from changelog entries: a user-facing summary (user changes, breaking first) and full developer notes (every entry).

entries.description: Changelog entries to render (at least one)

audience.description: Who the entry is written for: user, developer, or both (optional, default "both")

breaking.description: True for a breaking change (optional, default false)

group.description: Changelog group, e.g. Added, Fixed, Changed

group_order.description: Group ordering; unlisted groups follow in first-appearance order (optional)

version.description: Release version the notes are for

name: generate_release_notes
